title: The Last Thorn Anew
author: Silas Yarrow
blurb: Ines Galloway, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
